generation.scope: Finish all reduced split auxiliary binary determinants, including the two-node and tacnodal cases and mixed Moebius transitions. The nodal chart forces a common pair of coordinates and a common involution line of secants; the tacnodal chart forces the singular coordinate to agree everywhere. All one-dimensional point-fiber graphs now have finite all-degree regularity and indexed-isomorphism atlases, including the residual twisted cubic with its nonreduced finite structure.

open_mathematics: Continue the finite twenty-point graph branch at high opposite rank and positive-dimensional projection fibers, then determine global components and specializations. One-dimensional coverage alone is not completion.
